detail.title: Thermodynamic Costs of Memory Reliability (Revised)
detail.summary: Energy costs and retention times in physical memories are fundamentally bounded by coarse-graining and non-equilibrium dissipation constraints, modulated by nonreciprocal information flows and operational log retention factors.
detail.reason: Revising the thermodynamic memory notebook incorporating new evidence on nonreciprocal information engines and cost-aware retention metrics.
